findings.impact: A previously accepted profile can be refused on import; manifests written by older tools are rejected.
findings.workaround: Add a non-empty id to the storage entry.
findings.release_decision: DEFER as P2. W06 is CLOSED, so a closed_owner_repair transaction must either correct the validation contract or correct the fixture.

findings.title: Invalid UTF-8 remote path is not rejected by the SSH/SFTP backend
findings.expected: An invalid UTF-8 remote path raises UnicodeDecodeError rather than being silently mangled.
findings.observed: No UnicodeDecodeError is raised; the path is accepted.
findings.impact: A wrong-target remote operation is possible if a caller supplies malformed path bytes. No data loss observed.
findings.release_decision: DEFER as P2, with the wrong-target risk stated explicitly. W03 is CLOSED; a closed_owner_repair transaction is required.
